instruction: An urban rooftop garden at dusk: raised planter beds with vegetables and flowers, a pergola wrapped in vines and string lights, lounge chairs around a low fire table, a small greenhouse cabinet, a rooftop water tank on a stand, potted trees, and a silhouetted city skyline with lit windows beyond the parapet. user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Rooftop Garden Terrace. An urban rooftop garden at dusk: raised planter beds with vegetables and flowers, a pergola wrapped in vines and string lights, lounge chairs around a low fire table, a small greenhouse cabinet, a rooftop water tank on a stand, potted trees, and a silhouetted city skyline with lit windows beyond the parapet. String lights sway in the breeze. Style: contemporary cozy. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
